A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).

Class that describes a process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sourceArtifact

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ai

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clear

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeNotPresent

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: track
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability does not require action at this time. The organization would continue to track the vulnerability and reassess it if new information becomes available. CISA recommends remediating Track vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: testedOn

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: patchedBy

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directDownload

An individual human being.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assessment

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: follows
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` Element succeeds the `from` Element, establishing a unidirectional sequence. This succession is defined as chronological, procedural, or logical. rdf:Description.rdfs:label: delegatedTo

Inspection Process defines specific various processes needed to satisfy the inspection requirements for a specific product or service.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtimeAnalysisReport

The point in time when an element or an action starts, becomes applicable, or becomes valid.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDeclaredLicense
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact was discovered to actually contain each `to` /SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo (for example, as detected by automated tooling).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: compliance
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contact point for compliance (i.e. export control, licensing).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: critical

Preprocessing steps applied to the training data before the model training.
An Individual Value for Element representing a set of Elements with cardinality (number/count) of zero.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: executable
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an Artifact that can be run on a computer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: device
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element refers to a chipset, processor, or electronic board.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has other specific context information necessary to capture that the above set of enumerations does not handle.
Quantity is the amount in the selected QUDT unit.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [European Legislation Identifier (ELI)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/content/help/eurlex-content/eli.html) is a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) that uniquely identifies a legal resource, typically consisting of a document type, adoption year, and document number (e.g., `http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/2847/oj`).
Identifies the text of one or more copyright notices for a software Package, File or Snippet, if any.
Energy quantity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: module
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a module of a piece of software.
The amount or measure of a bulk product.
Unit of energy consumption.
Abstract ancestor class for all vulnerability assessments.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: model
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a machine learning or artificial intelligence model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: observation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Documentation of direct monitoring or witnessing of the demonstration of processes, tests, or any kind of system responses during a specified timeframe under specified environmental conditions.
Provides a reference number that can be used to understand how to parse and interpret an Element.
Specifies a country code where a software service is hosted.
A set of geographic point location coordinates.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: asilA
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Automotive Safety Integrity Level A under ISO 26262.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: invokedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element was invoked by the `to` Agent, during a LifecycleScopeType period (for example, a /Build/Build element that describes a build step).
The DefinedType class associates a specific type with its defined source.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inconclusive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Inconclusive refers to a result or outcome from a verification, test, or analysis that cannot be clearly classified as either positive (successful, pass) or negative (failed, reject). An inconclusive result means there was not enough clear evidence, data, or signal to make a definitive determination, and further investigation or additional testing is necessary. An inconclusive result always shall need a comment on it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md5
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD5 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1321](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1321/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: kev

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: releaseHistory

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: componentAnalysisReport

An inspection action refers to a specific activity or set of activities performed during an inspection to examine, verify, or evaluate an item, process, or system.
A distinct unit representing a constraint associated with an item's use in a system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: autonomous
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 6 - Autonomous. The system is capable of modifying its intended domain of use or its goals without external intervention, control or oversight.
Refers to any object that stores content on a computer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasResolution

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ark
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Archival Resource Key (ARK)](https://arks.org/about/), is a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) suited to being a persistent identifier for information objects of any type, standardized by the [ARK Identifier Scheme](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-kunze-ark/) Internet-Draft. It consists of the "ark:" label followed by a Name Assigning Authority Number, a forward slash, a name, and an optional qualifier (e.g., `ark:12148/btv1b8449691v/f29`).
It is the authoritative or credible entity, document, or body of knowledge that provides the meaning of a type, ensuring accuracy, context, and standardization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasPrerequisite

Location of a specific action.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedBy

Base domain class from which all other SPDX 3 domain classes derive.
ISO level of automation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md2
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD2 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1319](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1319/).
evidenceCategory refers to a category of documented or observable proof.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: duns
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Data Universal Numbering System (D-U-N-S) Number](https://www.dnb.com/en-us/smb/duns.html) is a unique nine-digit identifier, issued by Dun & Bradstreet, that identifies a business entity, often on a location-specific basis.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reportedBy

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cpe23

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: x509Cert
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an X.509 certificate as defined in [RFC 5280](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc5280/). The primary media type shall be `application/pkix-cert`. rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amber

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nli

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nuget
